name: get
summary: Read the authoritative state of a world door.
description: IDs are opaque hex strings. The bucket defaults to 0. The result is a copy and may exist before the native object streams.

name: list
summary: List registered doors with bounded pagination.
description: Bucket may be nil for all buckets. Offset defaults to 0, limit to 16 (maximum 16). Pagination is not transactional; rescan if the registry changes.

name: near
description: Position is {x,y,z}. The radius must be positive and no more than 120 metres. At most 16 closest doors are returned.

name: register
summary: Register or claim a world door for the calling resource.
description: A new descriptor requires id and position; bucket defaults to zero. Optional automatic, autoClose, lift, elevatorId and elevatorFloor describe initial topology. Claims preserve an existing door's state; another resource's ownership cannot be stolen.

name: configure
summary: Configure a door atomically on the server.
description: Requires ownership. Fields: open, locked, sealed, automatic, autoClose, defaultAccess, openRadius, closeRadius, closeDelay. Radii 1–12m, closeRadius >= openRadius, delay 0.2–60s. Invalid patches change nothing. Locks/seals close the door; lift opening is controlled by the elevator.

name: setOpen
summary: Set a non-elevator door's target state.
description: Requires ownership. Disable automatic mode and autoClose if a scripted open state must persist. This cannot override elevator safety, a lock or a seal.

name: setLocked
summary: Lock or unlock a shared door.
description: Requires ownership and a strict boolean. Locking closes the door and blocks all players, including access-granted players.

name: setSealed
summary: Seal or unseal a shared door.
description: Requires ownership and a strict boolean. Sealing closes the door and prevents all player requests.

name: setAutomatic
summary: Enable or disable authoritative proximity opening.
description: Requires ownership. Automatic doors use fresh player positions in their bucket; NPC-only local proximity does not drive the server. Lift doors reject this operation.

name: setAccess
summary: Grant or deny a connected player door access.
description: Requires ownership. A boolean overrides defaultAccess; nil clears the override. Overrides are removed on disconnect. This shared physical door is not an anti-tailgating barrier.

name: linkElevator
summary: Link a landing door to its elevator and floor.
description: Requires ownership of a lift door. The lift must exist in the same bucket, have the zero-based floor, and be horizontally within 40m. Opening requires an idle, powered cabin at that floor with doorsClosed unset.

name: remove
summary: Release a door owned by this resource.
description: Stops projecting this registry record. Discovery may subsequently adopt it again. Owner restarts also release their records; persist rules in your own resource if required.

name: setDiscoveryEnabled
summary: Enable or disable acceptance of new discovered doors.
description: Existing registered doors remain managed. Use explicit server registration with discovery disabled for security-sensitive worlds; discovery is not a cryptographic attestation of client topology.

name: changes
summary: Read a bounded feed of authoritative door changes.
description: At most eight events per page, from a 512-event ring. Continue with the returned cursor; if reset is true, rescan list. Supports cross-resource observation without assuming a server event bus.

name: get
summary: Read a door's latest replicated target state.
description: This is a server-interest snapshot, not proof that the native object is currently streamed. Native Open77.doors.state(id) reads the local projection instead.

name: list
summary: List door states within this client's interest.
description: Offset defaults to 0, limit to 16 (maximum 16). Interest is bounded to 256 nearest doors and follows the player's routing bucket.

name: requestOpen
summary: Ask the server to open or close an interactive door.
description: Queue acceptance is not server approval. Listen to open77:doors:requestResult(id, accepted, reason). Distance, bucket, access and doorway occupancy are checked server-side. Automatic doors and lift doors reject manual requests.
